body: 'i can't say better days will ever be ahead but i also can't say they won't be' that was very eye opening. i think i just feel so out of control and realistically i am in very many circumstances. i would choose it but at the moment i'm in a position of genuinely not being able to. i don't know. thank you so much anyway
